about: Six places that changed and five that didn't, for the time machine (scripts/validate-years.mjs, npm run years). Each change was labelled by eye on 9 October 2026 from the pictures of each distinct capture in Esri's World Imagery Wayback (the 30 m patch around the point, and a 190 m view where that was unclear), as the two capture months either side of it and the classes before and after. The smoothing settings in engine/years.ts were chosen on these places, so they are a yardstick, not a held-out test.

places.name: Giga Texas, Austin
places.note: Farmland, cleared for the factory in 2020; its white roof from January 2022

places.name: Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas
places.note: A vacant lot until the stadium roof closed over it in 2020; the roof is white and ribbed

places.name: SoFi Stadium, Inglewood
places.note: Hollywood Park's turf, demolished by 2016; the stadium's translucent roof by 2022

places.name: Tesla Gigafactory, Nevada
places.note: Desert scrub, then a light gravel lot beside the factory (cars, later trailers)

places.name: Apple Park, Cupertino
places.note: The old HP campus, cleared and dug out by 2016, the ring's courtyard lawn by 2019

places.name: Amazon HQ2, Arlington
places.note: A parking lot, dug out by 2020, the towers' podium by 2023

places.name: Forest, Shenandoah
places.note: Woods every year; one capture is leaf-off

places.name: Lake Tahoe
places.note: Open water every year; one capture is glare-white

places.name: Field near Ames, Iowa
places.note: Cropland every year, mostly bare in spring pictures
